remarks:
Opportunity to own a corner vacant lot in the City of Buffalo, just a 3–5 minute walk to Larkinville. Located at 75 Van Rensselaer St, Buffalo, NY 14210, this approximately 28 x 127 lot offers strong potential for new construction or future development.

The corner location provides added visibility, flexible design potential, and easier access compared to many interior city lots. With Larkinville, restaurants, events, breweries, offices, and ongoing redevelopment nearby, this location offers a great mix of neighborhood convenience and future upside.

Buffalo and New York State continue to encourage infill housing and neighborhood redevelopment. Buyers may want to explore programs such as New York State’s Block by Block Homeownership Program, which supports small-scale infill construction of one- and two-family homes in cities including Buffalo, and Building Buffalo Roots, a City of Buffalo initiative focused on bringing new housing to vacant lots throughout the city. Program availability, eligibility, and site qualification should be independently verified.

Bring your plans and vision to this corner lot near one of Buffalo’s most active redevelopment districts.
